name: WebBrowserInstance
label: Web Browser Instance
description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

name: CheckCondition
label: Check Condition
description: Specifies what condition to check (e.g., contains element, contains text).

selectOptions.label: Contains Element
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page contains a specific UI element.

selectOptions.label: Doesn't Contain Element
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page does not contain a specific UI element.

selectOptions.label: Contains Text
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page contains a specific text.

selectOptions.label: Doesn't Contain Text
selectOptions.description: Checks if the web page does not contain a specific text.

name: FindType
label: Find Type
description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

name: SearchKeywords
label: Search Keywords
description: The value used to locate the element or text content.

name: CheckUiElementState
label: Check UI Element State
description: If true, checks whether the found element is enabled or disabled.

name: State
label: State
description: Specifies the expected state of the element (enabled or disabled).

selectOptions.label: Enabled
selectOptions.description: Specifies that the element should be enabled.

selectOptions.label: Disabled
selectOptions.description: Specifies that the element should be disabled.

name: TextToSearch
label: Text To Search
description: The text to search for in the web page body or title.

name: SearchLocation
label: Search Location
description: Specifies where to search for the text (e.g., Body, Title).

selectOptions.label: Body
selectOptions.description: Searches within the visible text of the page.

selectOptions.label: Title
selectOptions.description: Searches within the title of the web page.

name: Result
label: Result
description: Returns true if the condition is met, otherwise false.
